decision.explanation: The original sources explicitly state two distinct instances where Malika Sonnet was placed on a focus list. Document 1 (D1S3) confirms she was placed on the 'NL Gendergap maintenance' focus list. Document 2 (D2S15) states she was added to the 'WikiProject Badminton/tournament focus list' in 2018. Both answers are directly supported by the text and represent separate valid relations to the question asking which projects she has been listed on.
